title: Screenshake Datapack
description: Datapack that adds screenshake to your world. Could be used to resemble an earthquake or some fun minigames.
body:
This datapack turns on screenshake for your world or map. Could work to resemble an earthquake or make for some fun minigames.

﻿Datapack features adjustable settings, including strength of the vertical & horizontal shakes, as well as frequency & choosing which players will experience screenshake. To get started, run /function _screenshake:help

﻿Datapack created by Jerries. Please give credit if you use in your map or mod! Compatible for all Minecraft versions 1.21.2 onwards (including 26.1+).
